channel.title: Tim Conrad · Thoughts
channel.description: Thoughts by Tim Conrad: ideas he is working through and comes back to.

item.title: Encrypted patches, unlocked on patch day
item.description: Ship a security fix early as ciphertext and publish the key at release time, so teams can stage it and apply it together instead of racing attackers. A design on TUF, a release without a key server through drand, open source in private, and the air-gapped case. Narrated.

item.title: A humans.md for working with models
item.description: My repositories tell the agent how to work with me, but nothing tells me how to work with the agent. Who already uses the name humans.md, how models change under you, why feel is a bad meter, and a first version of the file, with a log for each new model.
